item.title: Assam Releases 35 Captive-Reared Critically Endangered Vultures for the First Time
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam has released 30 White-rumped Vultures (Gyps bengalensis) and five Slender-billed Vultures (Gyps tenuirostris) from the Vulture Conservation and Breeding Centre (VCBC) in Rani, Guwahati, into the 6th Addition of Kaziranga National Park & Tiger Reserve under the Bishwanath Wildlife Division on December 8. item.title: It’s Great To Be In The Place of Legendary Zubeen Garg: Post Malone During Guwahati Concert
item.description: GUWAHATI: American singer and rapper Post Malone performed in Guwahati on December 8, and during his address to the crowd, he said it was “great to be in the land of legendary Zubeen Garg.” The moment drew loud cheers from fans, many of whom were still mourning the loss of the beloved Assamese icon. item.title: States Directed to Appoint Census Functionaries by January 15; 2026 Enumeration to Be Fully Digital
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Registrar General of India has instructed all states and Union territories to complete the appointment of census functionaries by January 15, 2026. The directive, issued through a recent circular, forms part of preparations for Census 2027, which will also adopt a fully digital enumeration system and include caste-based data collection. item.title: Welfare PT &BC, P&RD, Education, Social Welfare Among Assam’s Worst-Performing Departments: CAG
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) has named and shamed several key Assam government departments for chronic financial mismanagement, exposing lapses so severe that thousands of crores of public money remain unverified, unaccounted for, or wrongly reported. item.title: Assam Announces Change in NHM Leadership; Abhijit Sharma Takes Charge as Executive Director
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam government issued an order on Tuesday, December 9, announcing changes in the leadership of the National Health Mission (NHM), Assam. The notification stated that Abhijit Sarma, Professor of Surgery (DACP) at GMCH, Guwahati, has been appointed as the executive director of the mission with effect from the date of handover. item.title: Major Hours-long Fire Continues to Burn in Guwahati Commercial Building; No Casualties Reported
item.description: GUWAHATI: A massive fire broke out at the popular Swagota Square building at ABC point during the early hours of Wednesday, December 10, triggering panic and causing extensive damage. The fire is reported to have started from Hamleys, a toy store, before spreading upwards to several floors of the SBI branch. The ground floor houses Sohum Emporia.
